items.text: The table's current, active source is a system called MASTERPIECE, which updated 241 rows today. A search across all available files found that name only once, tied to a completely different table (a supplier dimension). It is a real external system, but no process that loads this table from it was found anywhere in the available material

This dimension is a widely shared GL lookup: roughly 45 other tables in this warehouse, mostly GL and POS fact/snapshot tables, carry its key. Only one of those, GL_JOURNAL_ENT_TX_F, is individually confirmed by code; the rest were not traced one by one

8 confirmed processes insert placeholder members into this dimension when another process cannot match a department to a real one, more than were initially found. They cover general ledger journal entries, budgets, beginning balances, and receiving line items
Two more reusable placeholder-creation templates exist with no caller identified anywhere in the available material

The only load process found for this table is a one-time setup from 2013, the same reusable pattern already found on other dimensions in this project, built by the same author. Confirmed to have no active schedule and no live path that reaches it in the process files that reference it: it is a historical setup template, not the table's real ongoing load process
Most rows (5,318 of 5,935) carry a blank placeholder instead of a real system name, confirmed to be the default value left behind when a writing process never records which system it is
